decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The Local Planning Authority considers that due to the siting and appearance of the mast and ancillary equipment cabinets they would not harm the appearance of the area.  The development is in accordance with Adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), and ENV-B.1.7 (Telecommunications)

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 4 - The approved equipment shall be removed from the footpath when no longer required.

REASON: To ensure that there is not a proliferation of structures on the public highway in the interests of the appearance of the area.
description: The installation of telecommunications equipment consisting of one 11.7metre high slim line mast complete with three antennas, and two  associated equipment cabinets.
